tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Items must be received back and return records; what to do if customer says they sent an item but records do not show it received."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units: if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks; if the customer will send them later, the assistant explains that they must arrive first and requests nothing for them now."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "A person takes over the conversation when the customer asks for one, at any time; when the shop's decision on a request is that a staff member takes the case; or in a case this policy names: units the customer says were sent but have not arrived, a delivered order the customer says never arrived, and a request to refund shipping. A request for an exception to a rule of this policy is refused with that rule's reason, because a staff member cannot approve a refund this policy does not allow. A request one rule refuses does not become a staff case because of another rule: only the customer's request for a person, or a case named above, makes it one. After a refusal the assistant gives the reason, and the customer can still ask for a person. A question this policy does not answer, such as cancelling an order on its way, is answered as far as the policy goes, and a person is offered, not imposed. When a person takes over, every proposal of the conversation that is not paid is closed, and the person continues from there; a refund already paid stays paid."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. When the order has several payment records, or its one record is not valid, a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card: such a request is refused with this reason, and the refund can still go to the original payment if the customer accepts. A customer's statement that the original card was cancelled does not change where the refund goes; the card's issuer handles the credit, and the shop cannot promise where or when it appears."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
